description: Use for questions about the store and tracking, not the ads: "is my Pixel working?", "does my store work in the Instagram browser?", "why do visitors from my ads leave?". Returns whether the store works inside the Instagram and Facebook app browser, whether Add to Cart shows on mobile, whether the Meta Pixel fired, five store scores out of 100, the weakest product pages, and the "Problems to fix" for visitors from Meta ads (landing pages they leave straight away, app layers or buttons that ignore taps, store script errors, weak campaigns, slow pages), each with the numbers, why it matters, fix steps and example visits, plus where they leave. Also the top 3 causes of "Why visitors are not buying" (all of them: get_why_no_buy). For funnel rates use get_sales_funnel; for each campaign's visit to cart funnel use get_campaign_funnels. Saved data from the latest daily store walk and daily visitor review.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
